_how: Developer projects (prompts 26 §1 and 28 §2). partner=true: shown on the public map, the place card ('Partner developers here') and a showcase page, labelled 'Sponsored' (only once the developer has signed and paid, D6, D38). partner=false: shown only in that developer's private demo (/d/{demo}/). Facts only as published by the developer or its public listings, with the URL of every item in 'sources' and the date in 'checked'; prices exactly as published (null = on request). On the site, a partner's line must also be written natively in PT and FR ('lines': {pt, fr}); the English 'line' is used for demos. Built by scripts/developers/import.py. A hand-entered partner may add 'unitTable' (every home as the developer publishes it, shown on the showcase, no unit pages) and 'location' (stated facts with sources; distances are ours, straight line from OpenStreetMap). A project shown on the site without being a sponsor carries 'tag' {pt, en, fr} ('Seleção' / 'Our pick' / 'Sélection'), shown everywhere instead of 'Sponsored' (prompt 66); import.py keeps such a record as entered. A project may carry 'hero' {pt, en, fr} (one line) and 'heroImg' (a render): the map then opens its place on it, as the card's hero (prompt 68: arrival, the project first, the next questions, one more thing).
